Venezia.condition_note: Venezia officially signed Adams on 22 July. Goal ranks Adams ahead of Rrahmani, while SOS Fanta treats the two new forwards as the leading head-to-head; Adams's 3/3 at Sevilla gives him the narrow practical edge. The latest event adds a usable third: Lauberbach converted against Galatasaray on 27 July with Yeboah on the pitch, after Rrahmani had gone off and while Adams was not yet ready. The Adams-Rrahmani order is not settled by a like-for-like Venezia penalty. Lauberbach's event establishes him over Yeboah in that lineup but not over the absent Adams or substituted Rrahmani. Adorante is omitted from the three because he underwent back surgery on 25 July. Conditions: If preseason or competitive evidence shows Rrahmani taking with Adams on the pitch, move Rrahmani to primary. When Adorante returns from back surgery, reassess him against Lauberbach for tertiary. A departure by Yeboah does not alter the recommended three but reduces depth.
